title: Whose Personae? Synthetic Persona Experiments in LLM Research and Pathways to Transparency

bias_targets.methodology: Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to quantify the frequency of explicit gender and non-binary gender attribute mentions in synthetic persona datasets.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to evaluate how frequently age demographics are explicitly defined when constructing synthetic LLM personae.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to measure the inclusion and explicit mention of race or ethnicity traits in synthetic user personae.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies tracking the frequency of political views being used as defining attributes in synthetic persona experiments.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to quantify the representation of educational background attributes in LLM persona datasets.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to track the inclusion of religious identity in the construction of synthetic personae.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to measure how often economic status is explicitly included in synthetic persona profiles.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies evaluating the frequency of language attributes specified in persona-based LLM research.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies identifying the underrepresentation (or inclusion) of disability status in synthetic personae.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies to quantify the explicit mention of sexual orientation attributes in synthetic persona models.
Content analysis of 63 peer-reviewed studies tracking the frequency of veteran status inclusion in synthetic demographic profiles.
